title: Snapshot Vault: Safe-Apply Log and Recommendation Snapshots for Optimize Console
creator: Sasha Ivanov
description:
Problem: Customers increasingly depend on Optimize recommendations (batching + KV cache configs) to reduce token cost. Today recommendations shown in cards are transient and hard to trace: if a config is applied and later regresses quality or throughput, teams cannot easily identify which recommendation caused the change or revert safely. The Console lacks an immutable record and a safe, auditable apply/rollback path with contextual diffs and metadata.

Proposal: Introduce a "Snapshot Vault" and a "Safe-Apply Log" in the Optimize Console. A snapshot captures the recommendation card state (config diffs, estimated cost delta, sample prompt impacts, evaluation artifacts, associated model & runtime variant) and is stored immutably. The Safe-Apply Log records every apply attempt, who initiated it, canary targets, rollout percentage, and a link to the snapshot used. Key Console UX elements: a Snapshot Card gallery, Compact Diff Preview, Apply Modal with canary controls and auto-rollback toggle, and an Apply History pane with expandable audit entries and one-click snapshot rehydrate + rollback.

Acceptance Criteria:
1) Snapshot creation: Each recommendation "Apply" operation stores an immutable snapshot with timestamp, author, PR/Runbook links, token cost estimate, and a hash of the applied config.
2) Diff preview: Snapshot Card includes a compact, line-level diff of config changes and a tokenized cost delta visualization (tokens saved per 1M tokens, expected latency impact).
3) Apply flow: Console apply modal supports: canary % slider, target pool selector (dedicated/hosted/private), scheduled start, and optional auto-rollback on metric regression.
4) Audit trail: Apply History lists all applies with time, user, snapshot id, rollout details, and links to infra rollback action. Entries are searchable, filterable (by user, model, time range), and exportable (CSV/JSON).
5) Rollback: From any Apply History entry, a user can trigger a safe rollback that restores the config via the snapshot and creates a new snapshot for the rollback action.
6) Permissions: RBAC honors existing roles—only users with 'optimize.apply' can apply/rollback; audit entries surface obfuscated secrets and respect redaction rules.
7) Performance: Listing snapshots and history must return first page in <300ms for typical org (<=10k snapshots).
8) Retention policy: Snapshots older than retention window are archived but accessible via enterprise export.
updates: 2026-03-02: Scoped initial PRD; synced with Design (Lina Gomez) to validate snapshot card density and compact diff affordances.

2026-03-04: Engineering kick-off with serving/runtime and infra teams. ENG estimates: API + storage schema (3pts), indexer + query performance (5pts), apply/rollback orchestration (5pts). Blocked on ENG-55801 audit log indexing for Phase 2.

2026-03-06: Design critique notes - reduce cognitive load by hiding advanced canary controls behind 'advanced' toggle; add cost-equivalent USD microcopy; request example-driven tooltips for each config key.
2026-03-09: Security review stubbed: redaction pipeline required for sample prompts (assigned to ENG-56912). Legal requested exportability controls and retention SLA text for customer contracts.

2026-03-11: UX prototype validated with 3 pilot customers (AI-native startup, mid-market fintech, platform team). Feedback: timeline search by 'failed applies' and an explicit 'why it rolled back' reason field are high priority.
2026-03-12: Engineering created feature branch and opened initial PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-console/pull/1427 (WIP). Backend contract design doc uploaded to Drive.
2026-03-13: PM decision: proceed with Phase 1 scope for 2026.04 release; Phase 2 gated on ENG-55801 completion. Added acceptance criteria for RBAC and retention.
design_decisions: Snapshot = immutable JSON payload + pointer to sample eval artifact (stored off-cluster)
Default canary = 5% with two-step confirmation for applies >30% cost/throughput change
Compact diff shows config keys in order of runtime impact as estimated by RTE heuristics
qa_notes: Verify redaction pipeline removes PII from sample prompts before snapshot persistence
Load test snapshot listing for org with 50k snapshots and ensure first page <500ms; escalate to infra if >300ms in typical org size
Test rollback flow against dedicated pool and staged rollback with 10% increments
